verses.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.

segments.text: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.

verses.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.

segments.text: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.

verses.text: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

segments.text: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.

verses.text: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.

segments.text: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.

verses.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

segments.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.

verses.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.

segments.text: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.

verses.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame—those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!

segments.text: All worshipers of images are put to shame—those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!

verses.text: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.

segments.text: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.

verses.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

segments.text: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.

verses.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

segments.text: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

verses.text: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.

segments.text: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.

verses.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.

segments.text: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
